sloka: ततः स सञ्ज्ञामुपलभ्य कृच्छ्राद्वलीयसस्तस्य भुजान्तरस्थः।अवेक्षमाणः पुरराजमार्गं विचिन्तयामास मुहुर्महात्मा ।। ६.६७.८५ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa sañjñāmupalabhya kṛcchrādvalīyasastasya bhujāntarasthaḥ।avekṣamāṇaḥ purarājamārgaṁ vicintayāmāsa muhurmahātmā ।। 6.67.85 ।।

translations.english: Exceptionally strong Sugriva with parched grain and fragrant water showered on him in the royal path, being cool, regained consciousness.
